lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice reporting the main point of a short source without repeating every detail.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Explaining a short article about local recycling changes to someone who has not read it.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Selecting the main point, leaving out minor details, and clarifying relevance.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna summarizes a short local article about new recycling routines, and Erik asks what actually changes for residents.

main_focus.name: main-point reporting with det handlar om and poängen är att
main_focus.description: Use concise summary frames to report what a source is mainly about and why it matters.
model_examples: Texten handlar om nya regler för återvinning.
Poängen är att hushållen ska sortera matavfall separat.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use main-point reporting frames naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

useful_chunks: Det är inte alla detaljer som är viktiga.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use concrete recycling words while keeping the main skill on summarizing relevance.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person says they read a local article and offers a quick summary.
dialogue_shape.middle: They separate the main point from one minor detail and explain what changes in practice.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on one action residents need to take.

target_complexity.repetition: summary frames should appear several times with small variation

focus: the main point of the article summary
which detail is less important to the decision

sentence_focus: one sentence with texten handlar om
one sentence with poängen är att
one sentence separating a main point from a detail
